set_review.meaning: Different actions distinguish home comparison, disagreement, hospital departure, budgeting, applications, arrears, floor-plan search, documentation, handover and staffing cover. Titles carry details that are not directly observable, such as arrears and eligibility. Preserved conversation and evening-routine images depict their own lived-evidence situations rather than substituting a software-product problem.
set_review.edges: All twelve full-size assets inspected against the approved fading-edge example; no foreground object reaches a straight image boundary. Preserve the whole image in placement.
set_review.bias: Age prompts explicitly specify 80+ for older people, while relatives and staff remain younger. Men and women appear as active older decision-makers and as professionals. No inferred diagnosis or physical restraint. Some requested casting comes out lighter-skinned than specified; ethnicity cannot be verified from pixels.
set_review.limitations: Illustrations remain fictional. Age perception and intended situation recognition need viewer feedback. Do not use them as evidence. Integrated tile-scale checks remain with the app integration work.
